items.title: BerriAI LiteLLM Unprotected Alternate Channel Vulnerability
items.description: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code URI.

items.title: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) Code Injection Vulnerability
items.description: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server. An attacker could exploit this via crafted HTTP requests that access an unintended controller route from a public survey context and supply a crafted file-path or stream parameter during data import processing. Exploitation requires knowledge of a valid public survey hash.

priority.reason: Confirmed exploited (CISA KEV). EPSS 26% probability of exploitation within 30 days. CVSS v3 base score 9.8.

items.title: Perforce Puppet Enterprise Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
